summary.one_liner: Cerebro is an open-source, cross-platform Electron launcher app for searching and launching applications, files, web searches, and calculations, extensible with plugins.
summary.what_it_does: Cerebro opens a search window with the default shortcut ctrl+space. Core plugins let you search the web with your favourite engine, search and launch applications, navigate the file system with file previews, use a calculator, and run unit/currency conversions such as "100 eur in gbp". You can browse and install more plugins by typing "plugins" in the search bar. Keyboard shortcuts include ctrl+1...9 to pick a result, ctrl+[hjkl] for vim-style navigation, and ctrl+c to copy a result. Light and Dark themes are supported, and settings live in a config.json file per OS. The README also describes the internal architecture: Electron with React, a main process, a UI renderer, and a background renderer where plugin initializeAsync methods run.
use_cases: launch applications from a keyboard shortcut
how_to_run: Download the latest version from the releases page (or build from source if no installer exists for your OS)
Clone the repository: git clone cerebro
For a packaged build: yarn package
notable: Plugin system with a background renderer so long tasks don't block the UI
Smart converter for units and currencies, including non-English queries
Plugins can be installed from inside the app by typing 'plugins'
Uses conventional commits and GitHub Actions to build and publish releases
caveats: Linux install requires making the AppImage or deb executable and may need sudo
A malformed config.json can break the app, so manual edits are discouraged
Building from source requires Node.js 16 or newer and yarn
